decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp U drop with opposing N/E motion around indices 485–544, possibly indicating a transient offset or jump; (2) a prolonged elevated U plateau ending in an abrupt multi-sample decline near 665–667 within 605–729, with unclear recovery. Both show complex cross-axis morphology warranting closer inspection.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt shift in U (downward) around index 490–492, accompanied by opposing E (positive) and N (negative) excursions; the U drop persists with possible partial recovery later, but no clear symmetric return is evident within the window.

U component exhibits a sustained high plateau from ~610 to ~660 (values >8), then a sharp multi-sample drop near 665–667, followed by noisy fluctuations without clear reversion; N/E show correlated transient offsets during the drop, suggesting a possible temporary offset or platform with ambiguous return.
